title: Order of Play on the First Tee
question: How is the order of play for players decided on the first tee?

choices.text: The order is taken from the list of tee times (the draw)
The order is based on who arrived first

explanation: On the first tee, player order is based on the official draw or tee time list provided by the organisers.
imagePrompt: Two teenage boys stand on the teeing ground. One is checking a paper listing the tee order while the other prepares to hit first.
imageAlt: Two teen boys at the tee; one checking the starting order, the other ready to play.

issues: Tee markers are a plain brown color, which is uncommon but not inherently unrealistic; standard colors (white, yellow, blue, red) might be preferable for clarity.
